newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS NEW WEEK STABLE TO FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS NEW WEEK STABLE TO FIRMER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted unchanged from Friday's levels against the U.S. dollar but registered gains on other hard currencies in early Monday interbank trade.

"We haven't seen much movement as yet. But we're expecting a number of tobacco inflows and the Zimbabwe dollar could appreciate a bit unless the central Reserve Bank comes in to buy U.S. dollar," one foreign exchanged dealer commented.

At around 0740 GMT the local unit was trading steadily at 11.3125/3225 against the U.S. dollar but was firmer at 18.7000/7100 from 18.7300/7500 against sterling at 6.5375/5450 versus the mark compared to 6.5400/5600 and against the rand at 2.5000/5075 from 2.5100/5300.
